title: 02. I Want to Join the Rainbow Class!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Today was finally here! It was Hori's first day in the Rainbow Class. His eyes popped open, and his heart went thump, thump. I want to join the Rainbow Class! He kicked off the covers and sprang out of bed.
Hori put on his new backpack and stepped into his new shoes. He twirled in front of the mirror. I'll draw pictures and build with blocks with my friends! Just thinking about it made him smile.
Hori held Mom's hand as they walked. Suddenly, he tilted his head. You're coming into the Rainbow Class with me, right, Mom? When Mom shook her head, Hori slowed down. But now I feel scared.
They reached the Rainbow Class. The colorful sign was still there, but Hori's feet felt stuck to the ground. Every step felt heavy. He kept fiddling with his backpack straps.
Just then, Toto, Kongi, and Dubu walked bravely through the door. Good morning! they said cheerfully. Everyone else seemed so good at this. Hori held Mom's hand even tighter.
Tears filled Hori's eyes. Mom, can't I just go home? He wrapped both arms tightly around Mom's legs. His nose tingled, and he felt smaller and smaller.
Mom knelt down to meet Hori's eyes and gave him a big hug. It's okay to feel scared the first time. I felt that way when I was little, too. Her warm voice helped Hori feel a little better.
It gets easier when you try. I'll wait right here. Then gentle Teacher Sheep held out a hand from the doorway. Hori, shall we go in together? At that soft smile, Hori reached out his hand.
Hori took a deep breath and waved bravely. Bye, Mom! At that moment, the stripes on his tail sparkled like a rainbow. His steps didn't feel heavy anymore.
At pick-up time, Hori bounded over to Mom. Mom! It was really, really fun! He had drawn pictures and played with his friends. It had felt scary at first, but trying made it much easier.
